quests.title: Two-position pentatonic fluency drill
quests.purpose: Develop clean fingering and seamless transitions between two adjacent pentatonic positions across the neck, staying in the chosen key.
instructions: Set a metronome to 80 BPM.
Choose a key (A major) and use pentatonic patterns 1 and 2 across positions 1 and 2.
Perform a continuous run, transitioning from position 1 to position 2 without pausing on the split.
Record a 60-second take and note any slips or string noise during transitions.
success_criteria: Clean fingerings for both positions with minimal string noise
Smooth transitions between the two positions at the target tempo
Keep the tonal center in the selected key throughout the take
Tempo remains steady on metronome during the run

evidence_required.purpose: Proof of two-position fluency with clean tone
must_show: Two-position pentatonic patterns played across neck

quests.resource_reason: Reference for major pentatonic patterns across the neck and their fingerings
quests.twist: Optional motif at end using both positions to demonstrate integration
quests.failure_route: If not passing, slow to 60 BPM and isolate transitions between positions; practice each position separately with clean fingering, then reattempt at original tempo.

quests.title: Smooth transitions between pentatonic positions (drill B)
quests.purpose: Refine fluid movement between two adjacent pentatonic positions while preserving key and tone.
instructions: In key of A major, practice patterns 1 and 2 across positions 1 and 2.
Use a metronome set initially to 70 BPM, ensure even tone with steady pick attack.
Shift between positions with minimal neck tension and no tonal center loss.
Record a 45-second take and annotate where tone or pitch wavers are observed.
success_criteria: Seamless transitions between positions with no tonal center drift
Tempo maintained within ±2 BPM of the metronome
No unintended string noise during shifts

evidence_required.purpose: Showcase smooth transitions with clear tone

quests.resource_reason: Provides fingering and layout for pentatonic shapes across neck
quests.twist: End with a 4-bar motif that moves from position 1 to position 2
quests.failure_route: If transitions fail, practice the two positions as separate drills at a slower tempo (60 BPM), then rejoin for a second attempt at 70 BPM.

quests.title: Two-position pentatonic drill in a second key (transfer test)
quests.purpose: Test two-position fluency in a new key to ensure shapes transfer across keys.
instructions: Set key to E major; use pentatonic patterns 2 and 3 across positions 2 and 3.
Play a continuous run, maintaining clean fingering and tone.
Increase tempo gradually from 70 BPM to 90 BPM as accuracy improves.
Record a 60-second take and note any fingering changes needed for the second key.
success_criteria: Accurate fingering in the new key for both positions
Key center maintained throughout the run
Tempo progression at or below target without sacrificing tone

evidence_required.purpose: Demonstrate two-position fluency in a new key
must_show: Two-position patterns across neck in E major

evidence_required.purpose: Audio evidence of accurate pitch and tone
must_show: Clear audio without crackling or noise during transitions

quests.resource_reason: Offers neck-wide pentatonic patterns and key mapping suitable for transfer practice
quests.twist: Include a short 8-bar blues phrase that uses both positions
quests.failure_route: If not passing, revert to drill 1 in A major to rebuild confidence and reattempt the transfer in E major after additional practice

quests.title: Neck pentatonic map discovery and peer sharing
quests.purpose: Create and share a neck map showing all five pentatonic patterns and their connections across the neck; gather feedback.
instructions: Sketch or photograph the neck map showing all five pentatonic patterns and their connectors.
Label the root notes and keys anchors; note how two adjacent patterns connect.
Publish image with a short caption describing how you navigate between two positions and any challenges.
Seek feedback from peers or instructor and summarize actionable insights.
success_criteria: Neck map clearly shows all five pentatonic patterns across strings
Root notes and key anchors are labeled correctly
Feedback is obtained from at least one peer or instructor and documented

evidence_required.purpose: Neck map photo with labeled patterns
must_show: All five patterns mapped across strings

evidence_required.purpose: Brief walkthrough explanation of neck map
must_show: Narration or captions describing two-position fluency in the map

quests.resource_reason: Provides guidance on pentatonic neck mapping and voice-leading across patterns
quests.twist: Color-code patterns to reflect movable shapes for easier navigation
quests.failure_route: If the neck map is unclear or lacks labels, redo the map with proper string references and labels, then reshare for feedback

quests.title: Demonstration: two-position pentatonic fluency over metronome (gate test)
quests.purpose: Directly test the milestone demonstration gate for two-position fluency with proper timing and tuning.
instructions: Prepare a 90-second demonstration of connected pentatonic patterns across two adjacent positions in a selected key (A or E).
Clearly state the key and positions at the start; play with a steady metronome (80 BPM).
Include an 8–12 bar blues phrase using the two shapes to show improvisation within the pentatonic framework.
Ensure clean tone, minimal string noise, and accurate fingering across both positions.
success_criteria: Clear demonstration of connected two-position pentatonic phrases across the neck
Key center and tempo are maintained throughout the demonstration
Two-position transitions are seamless and musically coherent
Demonstration includes a blues phrase from the two shapes with proper phrasing

evidence_required.purpose: Gate-level demonstration video for two-position fluency

must_show: No drift in tonal center despite transitions

quests.resource_reason: Direct gate material for two-position pentatonic fluency with explicit fingering
quests.twist: Narrate fingering choices during the transition to demonstrate understanding
quests.failure_route: If the gate is not passed, schedule a corrective demo after practicing drills 1–3 and receiving instructor feedback

design_notes: The milestone ms-02-two-position-pentatonic emphasizes mapping pentatonic patterns across the neck and achieving fluency between two adjacent positions.
Quests 1–3 target drill-based skill-building for fingering, transitions, and timing with metronome.
Quest 4 encourages collaborative discovery and external feedback through neck-map sharing to reinforce neck connectivity.
Quest 5 demonstrates the gate for the milestone, ensuring observable proof of two-position fluency, tone control, and metronome-timed phrasing.
Resources center on JustinGuitar and WeissGuitar pentatonic pattern maps to ground practice in credible pedagogy.
Twists are designed to increase challenge without altering core requirements.
